Boat drink piña coladas.d: Rum, pineapple, coconut cream, blended. Umbrella.
Boat drink piña coladas.note: Say it with the crew: boat drinks.

Afterlife Advice deviled eggs.d: Six halves, yolks whipped with Dijon and pickle juice, smoked paprika, chives.
Afterlife Advice deviled eggs.note: Bar snack of the house since the booths went in.

Green chile queso.note: Joe Heff's booth gets first scoop.

Patty melt.d: Thin beef patty, Swiss and slow onions on rye, griddled crisp in butter.
Patty melt.note: The booth where the plan gets made.

Mile-high sopapillas.d: Puffed fried pastry pillows, warm honey, a dust of cinnamon.
Mile-high sopapillas.note: Give it a name. Call it dessert.
